title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
description: Find the length of the longest substring containing the same letter after replacing at most k characters.

steps.note: Initialize sliding window with string 'AABAB', k=1
Expand window, A is most frequent (count: 1)
Expand window, A is most frequent (count: 2)
Window size 3, maxFreq 2. (3-2) <= 1, no shrink needed
